text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle got injured during training, 
so I rushed her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The doctor said it's all fine too! We can 
resume training starting tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, perfect timing! I'm so happy I can 
relax in bed, YES!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
A comic I borrowed from a friend recently 
was so good that I couldn't help but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oops! Sorry! Please pretend you didn't 
hear that just now!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! I'll go get a good night's sleep!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Now, let's get right back to the 
comic...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
NOOOOO!! I left the comics back in my dorm 
roooom!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Please go get it from my room for 
me!! Right now!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: NOOOOOOO!!

...Trainers are generally not allowed 
inside the dormitory rooms by rule. I 
decided to make sure she rested up 
properly for the day.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh nooo...!! And I was so looking forward 
to it...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Then what should I do?! Staying in bed is 
so, so boring!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Weeell... Trainer-san is so strict.

Just as the doctor diagnosed, it wasn't 
serious, but Taiki Shuttle still seemed 
disheartened.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...However, I understand. I can sense how 
worried you are, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay! Instead of comics, I'll kill time 
watching funny movies!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh?!

The next day, Taiki Shuttle felt all 
better, and we were able to resume 
training right away.
